newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Five killed in accident at Ukrainian coal mine.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in accident at Ukrainian coal mine.

text.p: Five miners in the eastern Ukrainian Donbass coalfield were killed when a block of ice crashed into the lift they were using to get from the coalface, a local emergency official said on Saturday.
Murtazi Churadze said the accident took place late on Friday at the Karl Marx mine in the town of Yenakiyevo, some 50 km (30 miles) northeast of the regional centre of Donetsk.

"The ice fell when miners were on their way to the surface after their shift. Five were killed, five were injured and taken to hospital," he said, adding that the miners were some 400 metres (1200 feet) below the surface when the accident happened.
The worst fatal accident in the Donbass coalfield occured in June 1992 when 60 miners were killed after a gas explosion.
